windHearth.name: Stone Windbreak Hearth
windHearth.detail: Stone walls reduce fuel use in storms and extend the campfire's light radius.

kiln.name: Charcoal Kiln
kiln.detail: Open the inventory near the campfire to turn Wood into long-burning Kiln Charcoal.

dryingRack.name: Herb Drying Rack
dryingRack.detail: Open the inventory near the campfire to dry herbs into pouches that heal and resist cold.

watchPyre.name: Watch Beacon
watchPyre.detail: When the campfire is lit, the eastern Watch Beacon lights the perimeter and blocks raids from the east.

stakes.name: Stake Trap
stakes.detail: Outer stakes slow enemies and spikes deal damage.

stoker.name: Self-Feeding Hearth
stoker.detail: When the fire runs low at night, it automatically uses fuel from inventory, starting with Kiln Charcoal.

wellhead.name: Restore the Well
wellhead.detail: An equipped Watering Can fills automatically near the camp well.

restCorner.name: Set Up a Rest Corner
restCorner.detail: Sleeping in the camp bed costs 4 fewer fullness points.

feedingTrough.name: Add a Coop Feeder
feedingTrough.detail: Camp chickens produce one extra egg per cycle.
